description:
FOR TEST CASES ONLY. NOT for reusable functions: if the user names an `FN_*` key or asks to snapshot / create a new version of a function, use `fn_save_as_new_version` instead. Trigger words for THIS tool: "test case", "TC", "TC_", "scenario", "script".

Freeze the CURRENT server state of a test case under a NEW version name — same TC id, a new version row with cloned steps. Mirrors the SimplifyQA UI "Save as new version" dialog (operation: SAVENEWVERSION). `tcId` accepts the numeric id or business key (`TC_*`).

`versionName` must be unique for this TC — the backend rejects duplicates.

TESTDATA — TWO-STEP: call once WITHOUT `tdCopy` to get the "Copy Test Data" prompt and confirm with the user; then call again with `tdCopy` set. Mirrors the FE's "COPY TEST DATA" modal (Cancel = false, Confirm = true). The tool REFUSES to snapshot until `tdCopy` is passed — the prompt step is not skippable.

`tdCopy:true` clones the source version's testdata iterations across every environment. `tdCopy:false` copies only the column STRUCTURE — one empty iteration (`ITR-1`) per environment; cells fall back to each parameter's project-level `defaultValue` if any.

`sourceVersionId` picks which version to snapshot; omit to snapshot the TC's currently selected version. Requires a live connection.

fromDraftId.description: Freeze THIS edited draft as the new version instead of the stored state — the "update + save as new version" path. Load it first with tc_draft_from_tc({tcId}) (+ tc_draft_update), then pass its draftId here. Without it the tool clones the CURRENT server state (pure snapshot).

sourceVersionId.description: Version to snapshot; defaults to the TC's current version.

sourceVersionName.description: Version to use, by NAME/number as the user says it (e.g. "v2", "2"). Preferred over sourceVersionId — the user should never need an id. If the source has several versions and this is omitted, the tool lists them and asks.

tcId.description: The test case id or business key (e.g. TC_123).

tdCopy.description: REQUIRED to actually snapshot. Clone testdata iterations from the source version. Omit on the first call to get the confirmation prompt; ask the user, then call again with the chosen value.

versionName.description: Name for the new version. OMIT to auto-increment (v1.0 → v2.0 → v3.0 …) from the versions already on the TC — the normal path for an update. If given it must be unique for this TC.

name: tc_save_as_new_version
title: Snapshot a test case as a new version
